text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: eval-gate ALERT: output-drift detected for model redwood-13b-quant (serving-group: hosted-prod). Gate: prompt-quality-regression. Threshold breached: 7.4% fail-rate (window=15m) — paging oncall. See eval dashboard: https://redwood.internal/evals/7890

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident triggered (PD-INC-4218) — Page fired to team: inference-oncall. Severity: P2. Escalation: 10m. Link: https://pd.redwood/incs/PD-4218

mira (oncall): acked. I'm on it. Starting triage — pulling recent eval snapshots and logs.

alex-sre: grabbing model deployment logs and tailing inference nodes. Can you confirm which customers are affected?

lee-ml: quick summary: automated eval runner saw an increase in hallucination/factuality failures on prompts in our financials prompt-set. Looks correlated with model variant redwood-13b-quant@v14 that rolled 03:02 UTC. v13 was stable.

sam-pm: @mira @lee-ml any customer-facing incidents yet? support tickets?

ops-bot: support-monitor: 3 new tickets in last 20m tagged "gen-output": CUST-4421, CUST-4423, CUST-4427. All mention incorrect monetary values.

mira (oncall): OK, customer impact confirmed for a small subset (3 direct reports + some webhook logs). Impact: incorrect numeric outputs in generation for finance prompts. Not triggering availability issues, but is a data-quality regression -> treating as P2.

alex-sre: logs show rollout events: 
```
2026-03-14T03:02:12Z rollout start redwood-13b-quant@v14
2026-03-14T03:02:34Z traffic split 80% v14 / 20% v13
2026-03-14T03:16:00Z eval-gate fail window breach
```

lee-ml: hypothesis: quantization pass in v14 introduced subtle bias on numeric tokens; eval set has lots of currency tokens. Need to pin model and revert rollout.

mira (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout and pin traffic to v13 2) open revert job 3) enable temporary safety filter for finance prompts 4) notify customers. Executing now.

mira (oncall): running command: `rwdctl rollout pause --model redwood-13b-quant@v14`

ops-bot: rollout: pause accepted for redwood-13b-quant@v14 (controller-request-id: c8f3b9).

mira (oncall): running quick revert: `rwdctl rollout revert --model redwood-13b-quant@v14 --target redwood-13b-quant@v13 --wait`

ops-bot: rollout: revert started. Estimated time to converge: ~2m.

alex-sre: re-routing 100% prod inference traffic to v13 via routing policy set: `rwdctl route apply --group hosted-prod --to redwood-13b-quant@v13`

ops-bot: route: applied. Current split: 100% v13. Health checks passing on nodes.

lee-ml: spinning up evaluation job now to re-run failing prompt set against v13 to confirm fix.

lee-ml: eval results (prelim): v13 fail-rate 1.1% vs v14 7.6% on the finance prompt-set. Looks like revert should reduce errors.

sam-pm: drafting customer comms for the 3 affected customers and a short note for the status page. cc: support.

mira (oncall): acked PD incident and added timeline note. I'm going to keep the incident open until we get 30m of stable eval windows and support confirms no more tickets.

incident-bot: PD-INC-4218 acknowledged by mira (oncall) at 03:28 UTC. Escalation halted.

ops-bot: post-action checks: traffic 100% v13, no new tickets in the last 12m for "gen-output". Health: OK.

alex-sre: quick ask for long-term mitigation: can we add an automated canary for numeric-heavy prompt-sets before full rollout? Lee, can we add specific currency token checks to the eval gate?

lee-ml: yes, we'll add targeted prompts + a stricter numeric-consistency metric to the gate. Also flag quantization passes for additional review. I'll open a spike PR.

sam-pm: please include a short blurb for the postmortem: root cause suspected quantization bias in v14; immediate mitigation revert and traffic pin; follow-ups: stronger canary, gate threshold tuning, customer notifications, stricter deploy checklist for quant changes.

mira (oncall): closing actions for now: 1) keep incident open until 03:58 UTC for monitoring (30m) 2) collect eval snapshots and attach to incident ticket PD-4218 3) work with support on customer replies 4) schedule postmortem meeting.

incident-bot: Note: incident will transition to "monitoring" phase. If fail-rate rises again to >5% in next 30m, PD will re-page.

mira (oncall): thanks everyone. I'll update PD timeline and file first-draft postmortem after monitoring window.

alex-sre: thx — keeping an eye on infra but looks stable.

lee-ml: starting PR: #ml/quant-gate-fix with tests and numeric token checks. ETA EOD.

sam-pm: assigning follow-ups in the incident tracker now.

mira (oncall): last check before close: eval window at 03:57 UTC shows fail-rate 0.9% on finance set, support no new tickets. I'm moving this to resolved/monitoring.

incident-bot: PD-INC-4218 status updated: monitoring -> resolved (mitigated) by mira (oncall) at 03:58 UTC. Reason: traffic reverted to v13; eval gates green.

mira (oncall): filing postmortem notes and action items. If anyone has logs/snippets to add, paste them here.

alex-sre: pasted heap of interesting logs to the incident ticket (link).

lee-ml: added eval diffs and token-level diagnostic to the ticket.

sam-pm: will send customer follow-ups in 15m.

incident-bot: This thread will be archived to PD-4218 when postmortem is published.
